definitions.explanation: The activity of sewing by hand, or the items being sewn. Refers to practical sewing rather than decorative embroidery.

examples.english: My mother is good at sewing.
I spend my evenings doing needlework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、{縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなく→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{嘆|なげ}いている→嘆く：11814_nageku⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother laments that her eyesight has gotten worse and she can no longer do sewing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{縫|ぬ}う→縫う：00326_nuu⟧ (to sew) and ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). Refers both to the activity of hand sewing and to the items being sewn. Has a warm, domestic connotation.

USAGE:
Typically refers to hand sewing done at home, including mending clothes, making simple garments, or hemming. More everyday and informal than ⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to do sewing
- {縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ — to be good at sewing
- {縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ — sewing supplies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧ — sewing, needlework (more formal, broader scope)
- ⟦{手芸|しゅげい}→手芸：07062_shugei⟧ — handicrafts (broader, includes knitting, crochet, etc.)
- ⟦{刺繍|ししゅう}→刺繍：05411_shishuu⟧ — embroidery (decorative stitching)
